title: Argentinian Empanada Bites
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, these bite-sized treats are filled with savory ham and parma cheese, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a small bowl, mix together diced ham, shredded parma cheese, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Place a small spoonful of the ham and cheese mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water, and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each empanada.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the empanadas are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Optional: Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro before serving.
